message:
The users API test passes now. The fix is two lines in `src/api/users.js`: the code used the column name `full_name`, but the schema that production has (from migration 001) names it `fullname`. I changed both the insert in `createUser` and the read in `getUser` to use `fullname`.

I didn't touch `migrations/`, since the DBA team owns it. `npm test` passes (1 of 1). Nothing is committed.
